responsibility: This public header defines GCC’s garbage-collected allocation interface and the core GTY-facing APIs. It declares root-table structures, mark and PCH traversal hooks, collector control functions, typed allocation helpers such as ggc_alloc and ggc_cleared_alloc with optional finalization, GC-aware string allocation, collection/trim/grow entry points, and related support used throughout the compiler to allocate GC-managed trees, gimple, RTL, and auxiliary objects.
